name: Louis C. Hay
role: Belfield Townsite Company agent; Belfield editor
bio: Louis C. Hay of the Belfield Townsite Company announced in March 1884 that the company's agent in Sweden had organized a colony of 500 settlers for Belfield, and he was named as a commissioner in the county organization that was postponed that June. He was put in nomination at the September 1884 convention but declined, and by May 1885 he and George Auld were editing a newspaper published by the Mandan Times.
